planning_target.planning_purpose: 把已批准的小说构思自主工作流 V2 框架实现为可运行、可迁移、可验收的技能链。
planning_target.acceptance_object: 正式 V2 技能运行器、公共 harness、测试证据与整链完成语义
planning_target.planning_boundary: planning-only; this package does not implement production changes or claim skill delivery.

authority_order: legacy docs/scripts as migration evidence only
source_interpretation.current_state: V2 contracts and 46 reference tests exist; most domain skills have no production runner; Q1/H1 scripts remain legacy 1.x.
source_interpretation.root_problem: contracts are formalized but executable semantics are fragmented or absent; without one official runtime and coordinator, per-skill implementations will drift.
source_interpretation.implementation_principle: shared semantics first, domain stages in authority order, packaging/review last, one final acceptance gate.

development_scope.migration_rule: legacy D1/R1 scripts may be read for reusable behavior but cannot satisfy V2 completion.

project_stack.test_framework: stdlib unittest plus explicit subprocess/DOM checks as needed
project_stack.schema: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 via production dependency
project_stack.dependency_risk: repository lacks a root dependency manifest; TASK-001 must establish a harness-local reproducible policy before runtime code is accepted.

phase_reports.purpose: 把 V2 权威链转换为实现范围、公共底座、迁移边界与验收模型。
review_checks: 未把 legacy 脚本视为完成

phase_reports.purpose: 形成职责单一、可独立验收的实现任务包。
逐任务审查实现逻辑、真实性边界与证据闭环。
审查整链覆盖、DAG、迁移顺序和最终交付门。
review_checks: 所有实现任务被最终验收依赖
